name: Perampanel
summary: Perampanel (Fycompa) is a seizure medicine that blocks AMPA glutamate receptors in the brain, calming the overactive nerve signals behind seizures.
description: Perampanel (Fycompa) is a seizure medicine. It blocks AMPA receptors, a type of glutamate receptor in the brain and spinal cord. Glutamate is a chemical messenger that excites nerve cells, so blocking these receptors calms the overactive nerve signals behind seizures. It is approved for partial-onset (focal) seizures, with or without spreading to both sides of the brain, in people aged 4 and older, and for primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures in people aged 12 and older.
